stat_dirichlet.idea: Hierarchical Dirichlet: prior mean = type-level class frequencies (fit-split histories) tilted by type x query-signal (fit-split query labels, strength 50); machine posterior from exponentially decayed counts of its own observed ticks < cutoff.
stat_dirichlet.hyperparameters: decay in {0.90,0.95,0.97,0.99,1.0}; strength s in {1,2,5,10,20,50}, separately for short histories (<100 observed) and long; chosen by log predictive score of FIT-split query labels only (empirical Bayes)
stat_dirichlet.expected: beats FrequencyModel defaults; far below champion (no lag structure)

stat_markov.idea: Direct five-class lag-context mixture: experts = no context + single lags 1-8 + all lag pairs, contexts in 3 categories (0/1/2+), missing context -> expert abstains to machine marginal. Each expert is a Dirichlet over 5 classes smoothed toward the machine's decayed marginal; experts weighted by softmax(beta * decayed prequential log-likelihood) on the machine's own history.
stat_markov.hyperparameters: count decay 0.95, log-likelihood decay 0.995, smoothing a in {1,3}, beta in {1,2}; chosen on FIT-split query labels
stat_markov.difference_from_champion: no win/size factorization, no size regimes (no validation-derived constants), no sibling pooling, no stacker
stat_markov.expected: well above Dirichlet; below champion, gap mostly from size regimes + stacker

stat_decay_bma.idea: Bayesian model averaging over half-lives: Dirichlet posteriors at decays {0.80,0.90,0.95,0.97,0.99,1.0} with the stat_dirichlet prior; per-machine weights from each decay's decayed (0.98) prequential log-likelihood on the machine's own history.
stat_decay_bma.hyperparameters: prior strength s from the same empirical-Bayes grid
stat_decay_bma.expected: slightly better than single-decay Dirichlet, mostly on drift/shared_change

evaluations.A: fit on TRAIN (histories + query labels), predict VALIDATION, official slot_forecasting.rounds.score_round (development-exposed for the champion only; HE-09 candidates use no validation information)
evaluations.B: fit on VALIDATION (histories + query labels), predict TRAIN queries, five-class observed-outcome Brier, condition-averaged

extra_metrics: paired episode bootstrap CI vs champion and vs FrequencyModel (4000, seed 0)
20x: mean predicted p_20 vs mean target p_20 on validation; class-20x Brier component on train
decision_rule: No promotion. A candidate is 'interesting' only if A and B both improve on the champion with A interval excluding 0; otherwise report as negative/diagnostic result.
